name: mog
blurb: To outclass someone, usually in looks, just by standing next to them
title: Mog Meaning: What Does Mog Mean in Slang?
description: To mog someone is to outshine them, usually in looks, just by being next to them. It comes from AMOG (alpha male of the group) and spread from forums to TikTok.
answer: To mog someone means to outclass them, usually in looks, height or build, simply by standing next to them; if you got mogged, someone made you look worse by comparison. The word is a short form of AMOG, "alpha male of the group", a pickup-artist term. It turned up on fitness forums and imageboards around 2016 and spread through Instagram, TikTok and YouTube memes from 2021, where it now also means beating someone at anything.

body: The classic mog is a photo or clip of two people side by side where one is taller, more muscular or sharper-jawed, and the caption just says "mogged". Nobody has to do anything: the comparison is the whole joke. Dictionary.com describes it as clearly outclassing someone, especially in looks or athletic performance.

Looks-focused communities split it into kinds: a frame mog is about a bigger build, a height mog about height, a jawmog about the jawline, a hairmog about hair. In everyday teen use the word has loosened into "beat" or "outdo": a cat can mog its owner, and a good dish can mog the rest of the menu.

body.note: The word grew up in looksmaxxing and incel forums that rank men by appearance. Most people using it today mean it as a joke, but that background is why some find it harsh.

ul: "Stood next to my 6'5" cousin in the photo. Absolutely mogged."
"He walked in with the new haircut and mogged the whole class."
"My cat is mogging me in every picture."
"That second-place time got mogged by a full three seconds."
"Mog battle": a poll where people vote on who outshines whom.

body: Mog is one of the standard words of Gen Z and Gen Alpha slang, alongside aura and sigma, and it shows up in sports talk and celebrity comments as a playful brag. Calling a friend mogged is banter; rating strangers' faces is the part of the trend people push back on.

faq.a: Being mogged means someone outshone you, usually in looks or size, just by standing next to you or appearing in the same photo.
Alpha male of the group. It was a pickup-artist term, and mog is the clipped form that became a verb.
Saying someone mogs you is a compliment to them. Telling someone they got mogged is teasing, and it can sting if it is about their looks.
